name: StartupTrusted

sources.title: StartupTrusted submit — 'Join StartupTrusted', Google or email sign-in

conditions: Free listing requires adding the StartupTrusted badge to your website — automatic badge verification runs before submission
Free listings are approved only after manual review
requirements: Sign-in required — Google OAuth or email
A site that can carry the badge (free path)
Startup/business suitable for a 'verified startups' database
preparation: Startup name, URL, description, logo, category
Badge HTML deployed to the site before submitting (verification happens before the submission is accepted)
workflow: Continue with Google or sign in with email
Add the StartupTrusted badge to your site (free path)
Pass the automatic badge verification, then complete the submission
Manual review approves the listing; Pro ($11 one-time) or Featured ($19) skip badge + review wait with instant approval
watchFor: Badge verification is a pre-submission gate, not a post-publish check — you cannot even file the free form without it
Pro/Featured are one-time payments with 'permanent' dofollow links; Featured pins above all homepage listings
Same operator runs sister projects (LaunchIgniter, SaaSGrow, outdr.lol, MacIgniter) — expect cross-promotion
Manual review means the free path can reject or delay
countsAsLive: The startup appears in the StartupTrusted database/category listings with a detail entry.
unknowns: Manual review duration for the free tier
Submit-form fields behind the auth wall
Whether free listings carry dofollow or nofollow links
